classification: Within-design production composition bug; not a RED/test/authority contract change
cause: The newly wired ACL advance check incorrectly required standalone current/successor ACL closure candidates before adoption. Close stage owns the successor ACL in the genuine staged snapshot payload; adoption owns it only after snapshot authentication. Existing proposed refs carry no standalone successor ACL.
correction: Thread existing current/successor canonical ACL bytes through the private transition input. Require them during settlement stage. Preserve early cryptographic-only verify before snapshot I/O, then require final bounded ACL/adjacency validation after snapshot verification and before hot intent minting, cold material return, or pending candidate acceptance. Open both ACLs against bound object/epoch/profile/digests.
validatorCorrection: Original validator wrongly treated reporter skipped rows as active. Original validation preserved; future validation uses passed|failed as active. No runtime rerun is used to reclassify the first result.
